title: Align link parser policy and bounds
description: Review of 2auf.35 found C rejects every encrypted frame while Python/Rust and spec/test-vectors/frame.json accept unsigned E=1 frames; C also rejects canonical maximum unsigned payloads above LICHEN_MAX_PAYLOAD. Align C/Python/Rust/spec/vectors on rejecting all E=1 frames, permit any payload whose complete frame fits the 255-byte body limit, and assert canonical error categories rather than any generic parse failure.
acceptance_criteria: C/Python/Rust accept and reject the same positive/negative vectors; unsigned and signed E=1 both reject as unsupported encryption; canonical maximum unsigned frame serializes in C; negative vectors assert intended error categories; focused tests and three reviews pass.
notes: Completed in clean integration worktree. Unified all E=1 handling as encryption_unsupported across C/Python/Rust/spec/vectors; added exact negative categories; made C frame sizing subtraction-first and overflow-safe; accepted 251-byte maximum and rejected 252/SIZE_MAX; expanded RX capacity to 251; rejected MIC selectors 2..7; corrected LLSec/LENGTH/empty-payload spec contradictions; added pre-allocation guards and mutation-resistant tests. Final gates: C frame 14/14; Python focused 64 passed, 7 expected skips, Ruff clean; Rust lichen-link 68 unit + 2 integration + 1 doctest, fmt/clippy clean. Final three closure reviews: no findings.
close_reason: Accepted. 2auf.21 (E=1) already unified on this tree; the remaining gap was LLSec bit 7 (SIID): C treated it as reserved, rejecting every canonical signed vector (frame.json frame_with_signature 0xa1; link_frame.json broadcast_signed 0xa0, short_addr_signed 0xa1, signed_max_payload) that spec 4.2 + Python + Rust + vectors accept, while accepting stale S-only 0x20 frames the others reject. Fixed frame.c parser/writer: bit 7 = SIID present, MUST equal signature bit (-EINVAL mismatch family), 8-byte signer EUI-64 parsed/emitted, sizing includes signer (signed broadcast max payload 194; unsigned 250 per LICHEN_FRAME_PAYLOAD_MAX=255-5, old 251 note stale); updated link.h field docs; rewrote tests/frame/main.c onto current canonical vectors incl. both S/SI mismatch directions and signed-max 254-body round-trip; added Rust parity tests (S-only reject, 256-byte wire reject, 254/255 body write boundaries 250/251 and 194/195). Canonical categories asserted in all three impls' tests. Cross-impl verdict table over spec/test-vectors/frame.json + test/vectors/link_frame.json + frame_length_boundaries.json: 40 vectors, 0 disagreements (C -EINVAL/-EMSGSIZE/-EPROTONOSUPPORT vs Python FrameError/EncryptedFrameError vs Rust FrameError variants, same accept/reject + category family per vector). Gates: C frame 16/16, C schnorr48 1/1, cppcheck clean on touched files; cargo test -p lichen-link 109 passed incl. cross_validate_parse/roundtrip + shared_vectors, fmt/clippy clean; python frame suites 135 passed 10 expected skips. Pre-existing unrelated failures filed as project-LICHEN-worker6-43b7 (test_node.py collection), -xa39 (11 link persistence/TOFU failures), -m9m4 (fuzz_schnorr48 include), -yvci (cppcheck uninitvar in link_ctx/time_sync). Note: C schnorr48 transcript still omits signer_iid (RX verifies fail-closed) - belongs to parent 2auf.35 signature migration, not this bead.
